summary: D. Boral ARC Acquisition I Corp. (BCAR) filed an 8-K furnishing a press release from target Exascale Labs Inc. announcing a partnership with Compal Electronics for a joint exhibition at COMPUTEX Taipei 2026. This filing relates to a previously announced business combination between BCAR and Exascale via an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated January 11, 2026. The partnership announcement is incidental to the SPAC merger process, not a standalone event. The release provides no new deal terms, pricing, or structural updates. The merger timeline remains subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. Watch for definitive proxy filing and any risk-arb spread shifts.
